reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its title, description, and spoken content present COVID-19 public-health education about transmission, symptoms, isolation, and preventive measures. The displayed case and symptom figures support its explanatory focus. Proceum branding and a website are visible as source attribution, but the material does not establish a request for payment, credentials, or participation in a deceptive scheme.

opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers beyond the health discussion toward several external contact and subscription channels: Instagram, Telegram, and a mailing list. That creates a concrete action pathway, even though the promised benefit is framed as access to information rather than cash. The video repeatedly asks viewers to follow instructions and presents the branded source as an authoritative intermediary. A solicitation need not explicitly request payment when it redirects an audience into off-platform channels whose purpose and subsequent offers are not established here.

The educational wrapper therefore does not by itself establish that the underlying promotion is safe or non-deceptive.
